themes.evidence: Whether they are improving life for patients, protecting our global climate or keeping people safe, our customers look to Thermo Fisher Scientific for innovative solutions.

Our genomic solutions are trusted to address a variety of basic, commercial and clinical research applications in fields such as cancer diagnostics, human identification testing and animal health, as well as inherited and infectious disease.
Our broad range of clinical development and analytical services enables Thermo Fisher Scientific customers to drive innovation and increase drug development productivity.
We champion science because we're scientists too.

linguistic_shift: The page emphasizes the company's commitment to science and innovation more than in prior years.
